Review.scope: the second research package (2026-10-19, round 2): the documents that carry data a record cites (six products for materials one product short of a page or thin, chamber and enclosure statements, a conditional drying, fibre loads, two newer documents of held products, and two documents kept to corroborate a filing and a name); their values enter through the reading tools

NotAdmitted.Why: copies of registered pages and sheets whose digests differ (no edition established, D131), retailer listings (the price pipeline captures its own), documents of products held for stock, identity or the owner, polymer references (polymers.csv is frozen), and a 2024 eSUN catalogue whose drying column prints only dashes; archive/research-2026-10-20/disposition.csv says what became of each finding
